general.name: Standard Professional
general.description: Balanced presentation across functional skills, career trajectory, and practical outcomes.
general.promptModifier: Emphasize verified outcomes, clarity of impact, and strong functional mastery.

technical_engineering.name: Technical & Engineering
technical_engineering.description: Prioritizes architecture decisions, scale, technical stack depth, and quantitative performance.
technical_engineering.promptModifier: Focus on technical rigor, system complexity, reliability metrics, and concrete engineering decisions.

executive_leadership.name: Executive & Leadership
executive_leadership.description: Highlights P&L ownership, organizational transformation, board interactions, and executive vision.
executive_leadership.promptModifier: Frame experiences through strategic leadership, revenue growth, talent development, and governance.

creative_design.name: Creative & Design
creative_design.description: Centers on product empathy, portfolio case studies, user research methodologies, and brand craft.
creative_design.promptModifier: Highlight design process, user problem framing, prototyping craft, and business metric impact.

academic_research.name: Academic & Research
academic_research.description: Emphasizes peer-reviewed publications, grant awards, teaching, and experimental methodology.
academic_research.promptModifier: Highlight research methodology, citation impact, grant management, and theoretical contributions.

career_transition.name: Career Pivot / Entry
career_transition.description: Bridges transferable capabilities from prior domains into target industries with focused narratives.
career_transition.promptModifier: Translate previous domain expertise into target industry language with clear evidence of rapid mastery.

data.title: Career data
data.intro: This page covers only the career tools: your career profile, evidence files, drafts, practice sessions and other career records. Your FlacronCV account, CVs, cover letters, job tracker and subscription are managed in Settings.

export.title: Export career data
export.body: A copy of every career record and file we hold for you, as a JSON file. It is shared from a temporary copy that is removed afterwards. Preparing it can take up to half a minute.
